text: Testing is a vital part of software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like a single function, to ensure they work alone. Integration tests, on the other hand, check how these pieces work together, catching problems when different parts of a system interact. For many developers, test-driven development (TDD) is a powerful method: they write a failing test first, then write the code to make it pass. This approach leads to cleaner, more reliable software. Above all, a thorough test suite gives developers confidence. They can change or improve their code, knowing that any mistake will be quickly caught before the software goes to users.
